mapper.select: SELECT FROM bug WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bug (project_id, requirement_id, source_task_id, fix_task_id, source, title, severity, status, repro, file_path, detail, wont_fix_reason, found_at, fixed_at, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{requirementId}, #{sourceTaskId}, #{fixTaskId}, #{source}, #{title}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{reproduction}, #{filePath}, #{detail}, #{wontFixReason}, #{foundAt}, #{fixedAt}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE bug SET fix_task_id = #{fixTaskId}, status = #{status}, fixed_at = #{fixedAt}, wont_fix_reason = #{wontFixReason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
